name: @mj-biz-apps/sales-playwright-harness
description: Explorer GUI harness for bizapps-sales — proves CRUD through the real UI, not just through procs/GraphQL.
_comment: `type: module` IS LOAD-BEARING, not boilerplate. Playwright transpiles TypeScript to CJS unless
the NEAREST package.json declares ESM — and the repo root does not, because the Angular/MJ
packages there are built by tsc rather than run directly. Without this file, lib/env.ts fails at
config-load time with `SyntaxError: Cannot use 'import.meta' outside a module` and no browser ever
launches. The sibling bizapps-accounting harness carries the same declaration for the same reason.
